facts.fact: The Djibouti Ports and Free Zones Authority says DPCR Vision AI, launched in 2024, uses cameras and AI to detect potholes and cracks along regional transport corridors and locate them.
The Djibouti Ports and Free Zones Authority says DPCR Vision AI, an AI road-defect detector, was developed by Djibouti Ports Corridor Road and launched in 2024.
